Improvement Revenue and Tax Bonds (Taxable), Series 1997 (the Airport Bonds''), all or none, until 10:00 o'clock, a.m., C.S.T., on

at the Offices of the Mayor, Municipal Building, Tullahoma, Tennessee. The sale may be postponed upon notice given by Munifacts News Wire not less than twenty-four hours prior to the time bids are to be received. If the postponement occurs, the sale will be held at the time and date announced via Munifacts News Wire at least forty-eight hours before the sale. The School Bonds, the Water and Sewer Bonds, and the Airport Bonds are sometimes herein referred to as collectively the

ds and the Water and Sewer Bonds will be sold at a rate or rates not exceeding six and one-half percent (6-1/2%) per annum. The Airport Bonds will be sold at a rate or rates not exceeding seven and three-quarter percent (7-3/4%) per annum. All of the Bonds will be dated March 1, 1997. The School Bonds will mature on October 1 in the years 2008 through 2017, inclusive, with term bonds optional. The Water and Sewer Bonds and the Airport Bonds will mature on October 1 in the years 1998 through 2017, inclusive, with term bonds

optional. No bid will be considered for less than ninety- nine percent (99%) of par and accrued interest. The School Bonds and the Water and Sewer Bonds will be awarded to the bidder whose bid results in the lowest true interest rate on the School Bonds and the Water and Sewer Bonds. The Airport Bonds will be awarded to the bidder whose bid results in the lowest true interest rate on the Airport Bonds. The Bonds will be awarded on the sale date by the Mayor. The School Bonds and the Water and Sewer Bonds will be issued as qualified tax-exempt obligations'' within the
meaning of Section 265 of the Internal Revenue Code of (the Code'').

Bonds maturing October 1, 2008 and thereafter are callable on April 1, 2007 and thereafter as provided in the Detailed Notice of Sale. The printed Bonds and approving opinions of Bass, Berry & Sims PLC, Nashville, Tennessee will be furnished at the expense of the Municipality. Additional information, including the Official Statement and Detailed Notice of Sale, may be obtained from the undersigned at the Municipal Building, Tullahoma, Tennessee 37388, or from J.C. Bradford & Co., Attn: Tom McAnulty, 330 Commerce Street, Nashville, Tennessee 37201, telephone: (615) 748-9291.
